RSSB Exam Calendar 2026 – Full Details

Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB / RSMSSB) has recently released the Exam Calendar For The Session 2026 on its official website. RSSB has announce the Yearly Exam Notification Date & Exam Schedules for the all competitive examination conducted by the Commission ,For 17 November 2026 To 27 February 2026 Notification Date & Exam Dates are out candidates can download the Schedule form the important link section Or they can check it here too-:

Important Dates

  • Exam Calendar Released : 28 September 2026
  • Teaching Associate : 17 November 2026 to 21 December 2026
  • CET (12th Level) : 01-03 December 2026
  • CET (Graduate Level) : 16-18 January 2026
  • Lab Attendant : 25 January 2026
  • Junior Engineer (JEN) : 03-05 February 2026

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

Important Links

  • Download Updated Exam Calendar
  • Download Revised Exam Calendar
  • Download Exam Calendar
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is RSSB Exam Calendar 2026?

RSSB Exam Calendar 2026 is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
